candidates.title: School administration: orders and invoices

demandEvidence.chore: Handle school learning-material licenses, orders, invoices and some financial administration.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: hantering av läromedelslicenser samt beställningar, fakturor och viss ekonomiadministration

ease.reason: A spreadsheet could track one clerical category, but the vacancy gives no accessible tools or process detail.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school may value clerical support; a paid staff vacancy does not validate an AI offer.

feasibility.reason: A small fictional order and invoice tracker is conceivable, but school systems and rules are unspecified.

autonomy.reason: The notice names handling work, not an automated loop; humans must verify purchases and finances.

evidence.reason: The source establishes a paid human role and listed chores, not an AI product or service.

candidates.reason: Reject: the notice supports these clerical chores but provides no product evidence or AI-service demand; a prototype would be hypothetical and the workflow remains undefined.
